text:
Maybe someone has been in the same situation.
I’m Argentinian and my partner is Israeli. We had our visa interview a few days ago for the B1, and I was asked to provide police clearance certificates and proof of marital status from both Mexico and Brazil because I resided in each country for more than six months.

I contacted the embassies of both countries, but they told me they do not issue marital status certificates for foreigners, even if they previously lived there. They only issue these documents for their own citizens.

Has anyone dealt with a similar situation?
